findings.title: Bid Model Field Names Don't Match Schema
findings.description: Code uses .accepted (boolean) and rejectionReason, but Prisma schema defines status (BidStatus enum) and rejectionCode (string). This prevents Prisma code generation.
findings.consequence: Prisma client generation fails; all tests and compilation blocked. Cannot run or test any auction logic.
findings.correction: Replace .accepted with .status === 'ACCEPTED'/.status === 'REJECTED'. Replace rejectionReason with rejectionCode.

findings.title: Code Uses Non-Existent Auction Fields
findings.description: Code attempts to update Auction.highBidId, Auction.highBidMinor, Auction.highBidTeamId which do not exist in the Prisma schema.
findings.consequence: Bid acceptance updates fail at runtime. High bid tracking broken. Auction cannot function.
findings.correction: Either add fields to schema, store high bid on AuctionPlayer (not Auction), or query Bid table directly when needed.

findings.title: Settlement Service Uses Non-Existent Field
findings.description: settlement.service.ts line 59 uses auctionPlayer.selledFor which doesn't exist. Schema defines currentBidMinor, not selledFor.
findings.consequence: Players cannot be marked as sold. Settlement fails. Auction cannot complete.
findings.correction: Use currentBidMinor instead of selledFor, or update only status to 'SOLD'.

findings.title: Repository.withTransaction Does Not Use Transaction Instance
findings.description: withTransaction passes PrismaService to callback instead of transaction instance. Prisma.$transaction requires the transaction object as argument.
findings.consequence: Transactions execute outside transaction context. Concurrent bid operations race. Purse debit and bid acceptance not atomic. Financial correctness violated.
findings.correction: Change to: return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => fn(tx)); The tx parameter is the transaction instance.

findings.title: Bid-Validation Ignores Configurable Brackets
findings.description: computeMinimumBid() fetches brackets but then ignores the result and uses hard-coded PKR values. Violates host-configurable bracket requirements.
findings.consequence: Custom bracket configurations cannot be used. All auctions forced to use default PKR brackets. Multi-auction flexibility broken.
findings.correction: Build in-memory bracket lookup table from AuctionIncrementBracket rows. Apply correct bracket based on currentBidMinor and bracket boundaries (accounting for fromInclusive/toInclusive flags).

findings.title: No Authorization Check for Bidder Role
findings.description: bid-validation.service.ts does not verify that the user is a TEAM_OWNER, not a SPECTATOR. Spectators are read-only and must not be allowed to bid.
findings.consequence: Spectators can place bids, violating product rules and authorization model. Security boundary broken.
findings.correction: Add check in validateBidPlacement: query RoomMember and verify role === RoomRole.TEAM_OWNER before allowing bid.

findings.title: Event Broadcast Before Durable Commit
findings.description: Gateway broadcasts bid:accepted immediately after submitBid returns, before database transaction durability is verified. If transaction fails downstream, event already broadcast.
findings.consequence: Clients receive bid:accepted but database may still fail. State divergence. Reconnect recovery broken.
findings.correction: Move broadcast logic into AuctionsService after Prisma transaction commits, or use Prisma.$transaction callback to couple broadcast with commit.

findings.title: Prisma Client Not Generated
findings.description: Commit message states 'awaiting Prisma generation'. Test output confirms: Cannot find module '.prisma/client/default'. Code cannot run or be tested.
findings.consequence: No type safety. No test execution. No CI/CD validation. Cannot verify any changes work.
findings.correction: Run: pnpm db:generate (requires DATABASE_URL env var set to live database connection)

findings.title: Required Test Cases Not Implemented
findings.description: Phase G plan specifies 10+ mandatory tests: insufficient purse, invalid increment, deadline passed, duplicate key, unauthorized team, spectator rejection, concurrent race, settlement with squad rules, idempotent retry, etc. Only auction-state-machine.spec.ts exists (unit tests only).
findings.consequence: Critical functionality paths not validated. Regressions not caught. Quality assurance incomplete.
findings.correction: Create integration test files for each service: bid-validation.service.spec.ts, bid-acceptance.service.spec.ts, purse-ledger.service.spec.ts, settlement.service.spec.ts with all mandatory test cases.
